notes: Nine web searches ran; none was refused. The two site-restricted searches (hildasolis.org campaign site and hildalsolis.org supervisor site) returned no pages from those domains, so the official-site check is incomplete. The only related item found: on 14 April 2026, as Board Chair, she led an LA County motion to study the health and environmental impacts of hyperscale data centers (https://hildalsolis.org/los-angeles-county-advances-report-on-data-center-impacts-in-unincorporated-communities/, read at source). Her quoted remarks there do not mention AI; news coverage links the data centers to AI. She mentions a full moratorium lacked support, but the motivation is local impact, so positions stay none. Not a member of Congress in 2026, so she did not co-sponsor the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act or sign House letters. A March 2026 Congressional Labor Caucus AI letter appeared in results but she was not a member then.
